option_relations.rationale: Optic nerve astrocytoma is a broader category that includes anaplastic astrocytoma, which is specified in the leaf.
Primary optic nerve glioma is a broader category that includes malignant optic nerve glioma (anaplastic astrocytoma), which is specified in the leaf.
Optic nerve glioma (astrocytoma) is a broader category that includes malignant optic nerve glioma (anaplastic astrocytoma), which is specified in the leaf.
Glioblastoma (WHO grade IV) is a distinct entity from anaplastic astrocytoma (WHO grade III), even though both are astrocytic tumors. The leaf specifies anaplastic astrocytoma, not glioblastoma.
